metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Essex County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Silver Lake & Belleville Heights, Valley & Washington Ave Commercial Core
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 3.91%, with an equalization ratio of 66.1%.
Public education represents 51.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 31.8%.
Average residential assessment is $310,670, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,147.2.

neighborhoods.name: Silver Lake & Belleville Heights
neighborhoods.character: Historic 'Cherry Blossom Capital' bordering Branch Brook Park with traditional two-family homes, cape cods, and light rail access
neighborhoods.description: Township famous for the annual National Cherry Blossom Festival at Essex County Branch Brook Park.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Certified tax rate of 3.842% with major state formula aid supporting Belleville Public Schools.

neighborhoods.name: Valley & Washington Ave Commercial Core
neighborhoods.character: Dense town center with retail storefronts, two-family residences, and townhomes near Passaic River
neighborhoods.description: Vibrant commercial and residential corridor with convenient bus connections to Newark and NYC.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Commercial retail ratables provide essential non-residential tax support.

equityAnalysis.summary: Belleville Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Belleville Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,147.2 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 14.19% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 66.1%, assessed values average ~66.1% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 51.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.8%, and Essex County claims 16.4%.
